dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.description: Check album status and continue preparing your event.
dashboard.newAlbumDescription: Start by creating a new event album.

albums.title: My albums
albums.description: Event albums you own or manage.
albums.emptyDescription: Albums you create or manage will appear here.

createPage.title: Create an album
createPage.description: Create a draft album first. Continue event setup after the album is created.
createPage.conflict: The draft could not be created because of another change. Reload and try again.
createPage.error: The album could not be created. Check your connection and try again.
createPage.denied: You do not have permission to create an album.
createPage.reauth: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

detail.title: Album overview
detail.guestCountUnavailable: The participant count is finalized after the event ends.

readyPage.title: Activation status
readyPage.completeDescription: Setup confirmation succeeded and the album is now ready.
readyPage.pendingDescription: The server must confirm setup and return the activation result before this album can be marked ready.
readyPage.paymentPendingDescription: The server returned PAYMENT_PENDING. The current setup flow cannot resolve this status.

guestLimit.description: Set how many photos each participant can submit. This is not a participant count or the album's total capacity.
guestLimit.label: Photos per participant
guestLimit.distinction: Total photo capacity and moderation controls are not available on this settings endpoint.
guestLimit.saved: The per-participant photo limit was saved.
guestLimit.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving again.
guestLimit.error: Settings could not be saved. Try again.
guestLimit.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
guestLimit.forbiddenDescription: This account cannot set up this album.

collaborators.title: Invite a collaborator
collaborators.description: Grant setup, moderation, or export access independently as needed.
collaborators.noBilling: Payment and payment history permissions are not available to collaborators.
collaborators.conflict: The invitation could not be created because of a conflict.
collaborators.error: The invitation could not be created. Try again.
collaborators.empty: No invitations have been recorded yet.
collaborators.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
collaborators.forbiddenDescription: This account cannot set up this album.

accessPin.description: An album PIN is optional. Guests do not need to create an account to access an album.
accessPin.label: Album PIN
accessPin.help: Saving a PIN will set or replace the current album PIN.
accessPin.error: The PIN could not be saved. Try again.
accessPin.forbiddenDescription: This account cannot set up this album.

eventBasics.limitedDescription: The current album contract only accepts a time zone. Event name, location, and category cannot be saved here.
eventBasics.timezoneHelp: Use an IANA time zone name, for example Asia/Jakarta. The API does not return the current time zone.
eventBasics.conflict: The album changed elsewhere. Reload before saving again.
eventBasics.error: The time zone could not be saved. Try again.
eventBasics.invalid: Enter a valid IANA time zone name.

schedule.description: Set the photo capture period and when photos become visible. The server determines the reveal and payment cutoff times.
schedule.conflict: The schedule or album settings changed elsewhere. Reload the schedule and try again.
schedule.serverValidation: The server rejected the schedule values. Check the dates and times.
schedule.error: The schedule could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.

validation.startPast: The start time cannot be in the past.
validation.startTooFar: Schedules can be created at most three calendar months ahead.
validation.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.
validation.durationTooLong: The event can last at most 5 days or 120 hours.
validation.revealDelay: Choose D+1, D+3, D+5, or D+7.

packages.title: Available package options
packages.provisional: This list is informational only. A package choice is not saved and is not server-authoritative setup state.

review.title: Server setup status
review.limited: The review endpoint only returns the album status and revisions below. A setup completeness checklist is not available.

steps.title: Album setup
steps.unavailable: This setup information is not available in the current API contract.

host.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
host.forbiddenDescription: This account does not have permission to view that album.

reference.title: Kepotret, made for real moments.
reference.description: An internal reference page for checking visual language, accessibility, themes, and localization.
reference.motionDescription: Animation respects the device reduced-motion preference.
reference.emptyDescription: Content will appear here when it becomes available.
reference.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
reference.forbiddenDescription: You do not have access to perform this action.
reference.permissionDescription: Allow access through your browser settings to continue.
reference.confirmationDescription: Review this action before you continue.
